author: rob_bradford
title: Design: Pre-copy Live Migration with Dirty Page Tracking via KVM dirty ring
body:
Status: accepted

Context:
Virtual machine live migration must minimize downtime below 50ms while transferring guest memory under active workloads.

Decision:
Implement iterative pre-copy migration using KVM dirty ring buffer instead of classic user-faultfd or dirty bitmap.

Consequences:
- Drastically reduces lock contention during memory dirty page capture.
- Guest pause time under 35ms on 10GbE network.

author: sebastien_boeuf
title: PR #1042: Implement VirtIO Memory Ballooning with Page Reporting
body: Adds virtio-balloon device supporting automatic unused page reporting back to host hypervisor. Enables dynamic RAM overcommit without guest performance degradation.

author: wei_liu
title: Issue #890: Memory balloon deflation stalls under aggressive host memory pressure
body: When host demands quick reclamation, balloon thread deadlock occurred due to synchronous locking on memory allocation bus.

author: rob_bradford
title: Review on PR #1042: Reject synchronous balloon deflation
body: Synchronous deflation blocks guest vCPUs for up to 400ms. We must reject synchronous balloon worker in favor of asynchronous background worker thread.

author: anatol_bityukov
title: Design: Vhost-User Network Backend with Multi-Queue Support
body:
Status: accepted

Context:
Standard TAP networking limits packet throughput to ~1.2 Mpps due to kernel context switching overhead.

Decision:
Implement vhost-user-net backend delegating packet processing to DPDK/OVS processes via shared memory queues.

Consequences:
- Achieves line-rate 10GbE throughput (>8 Mpps).
- Eliminates kernel networking path context switches.

author: sebastien_boeuf
title: Design: Direct Linux Kernel Boot without Legacy BIOS/GRUB
body:
Status: accepted

Context:
Booting a full SeaBIOS or UEFI image adds 500ms-2s of cold start latency to cloud hypervisor microVMs.

Decision:
Implement direct ELF/bzImage loader jumping straight into the Linux kernel entry point with boot_params setup.

Consequences:
- Sub-30ms VM boot times.
- Eliminates legacy BIOS real-mode emulation code from VMM.

author: anatol_bityukov
title: Issue #940: High guest exit latency on unpinned multi-threaded vCPUs
body: vCPU threads migrating across NUMA nodes caused up to 300% tail latency jitter on latency-sensitive guest workloads.

author: rob_bradford
title: PR #1105: CPU Pinning and NUMA Topology Node Binding (Closes #940)
body: Allows operator to pin guest vCPUs to specific host physical cores and bind guest RAM to local host NUMA nodes using libc::sched_setaffinity.

author: sebastien_boeuf
title: Review on PR #1105: Reject legacy floppy and IDE device emulation
body: Emulating legacy PC hardware (floppy, IDE, PS/2) contradicts Cloud Hypervisor's minimal attack surface goal. Only modern VirtIO and PCIe interfaces will be supported.

author: wei_liu
title: Design: VirtIO-FS Shared Host Filesystem with Direct Access (DAX) Window
body:
Status: accepted

Context:
Container runtimes (Kata Containers) need efficient sharing of host root filesystems with minimal memory overhead.

Decision:
Support virtio-fs device with a dedicated DAX window mapping host page cache directly into guest physical address space.

Consequences:
- Zero guest page cache memory duplication.
- File reads bypass guest I/O path directly to host cache.

author: rob_bradford
title: Issue #1015: Host file lock contention in virtio-fs shared directory mounts
body: Multiple concurrent containers writing to shared virtio-fs directory caused POSIX file lock contention in virtiofsd daemon.

author: anatol_bityukov
title: PR #1180: PCIe Root Port Hotplug Support for VirtIO Devices
body: Adds ACPI PCI hotplug notifications and PCIe native hotplug controller allowing runtime addition and removal of network interfaces and disks.

author: sebastien_boeuf
title: PR #1240: Asynchronous Disk I/O via Linux io_uring Engine
body: Replaces threadpool synchronous pread/pwrite with io_uring submission/completion queue rings for virtio-block backend.

author: wei_liu
title: Review on PR #1240: Reject unbounded polling loops in vhost worker
body: Spin-polling io_uring SQPOLL thread pegging 100% CPU on idle guests is prohibited. Eventfd notification must be used when queue is drained.

author: rob_bradford
title: PR #1312: VFIO PCI Device Passthrough for GPU Workloads
body: Integrates VFIO Linux kernel API enabling secure hardware DMA remapping and MSI-X interrupt forwarding for dedicated guest GPUs and NVMe drives.

author: sebastien_boeuf
title: Design: ACPI Generic Event Device (GED) for System Notifications
body:
Status: accepted

Context:
Handling power button, shutdown, and hotplug interrupts previously required complex proprietary DSDT methods.

Decision:
Adopt ACPI 5.0 Generic Event Device (GED) providing simplified interrupt-driven event signaling across x86_64 and AArch64.

Consequences:
- Unified event dispatch table across architectures.
- Removes ~1,200 lines of architecture-specific AML bytecode.

author: anatol_bityukov
title: Issue #1120: Guest memory leak in balloon statistics driver queue
body: Periodic stat queue buffers allocated by guest kernel were leaked when host neglected to acknowledge polling rings.

author: wei_liu
title: PR #1390: MicroVM Minimal Device Tree Profile for Serverless Sandboxes
body: Configures minimal sandbox VM profile stripping ACPI tables and serial emulation, reducing guest boot time to 12ms for AWS Lambda style workloads.
